title: Access log for read accesses with compliance-profile retention
migration: Apps that mount audit run `kumiko-schema generate` and ship the migration that creates `store_access_log`.

title: Audit payloads follow the entity read rules; payload can be null
detail: `audit:query:list`, `details`, `list-all-tenants` and `details-all-tenants` checked only the tenant and redacted PII ciphertext, so a TenantAdmin read plaintext fields of entities restricted to another role. Now `payload` is `null` when the caller lacks the entity's query access, when the entity's `access.read` grants none of the caller's roles `"all"`, or when the entity has a `readGate` or `parentRef`. Otherwise writeOnly fields and fields whose read rule grants none of the caller's roles `"all"` are removed from the snapshot and from `changes` and `previous`. Other events on such an aggregate have their payload withheld if the entity has a field restricted for the caller. The rules apply to SystemAdmins too.
migration: Code that reads `payload` from audit rows must handle `null`.

migration: The audit feature now declares `r.requires("tenant", "user")`. An app that mounts `createAuditFeature()` without the `user` feature fails at boot with `Feature "audit" requires feature "user" which is not registered` — mount `createUserFeature()`. Apps using `securityBaselineFeatures()` already had to mount it.

title: escapeHatchUsedSchema.kind accepts the new unsafe-all-tenants EscapeHatchKind (fw#2913).
New escape-hatch-used audit sink: createEscapeHatchAuditSink records security:escape-hatch-used as audit:event:escape-hatch-used (fw#2861).
AuditLogScreen and AuditLogDetailScreen removed; audit-log/audit-log-detail are now declarative screens (fw#2312).
detail: `audit-log` and `audit-log-detail` render through the generic renderer (`projectionList`/`projectionDetail`) instead of custom React components — the renderer selects a screen by its `screen.type`, not a client component registry, so `AuditLogScreen`/`AuditLogDetailScreen` were dead exports the moment the screen definitions switched. The `payload`/`metadata` fields now use the `format: "json"` field-renderer (see framework changelog) instead of a raw escaped-string dump.
migration: Breaking only if you imported these components directly (no shipped consumer app did). Remove `import { AuditLogScreen, AuditLogDetailScreen } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/audit/web"` and any `components: { AuditLogScreen: ..., AuditLogDetailScreen: ... }` entry in your `auditClient()`/renderer setup — the bundled feature registers its own `audit-log`/`audit-log-detail` screens now, nothing left for an app to wire.
